items.source: Favor this bean naming strategy over AnnotationBeanNameGenerator if you run into naming conflicts due to multiple autodetected components having the same non-qualified class name (i.e., classes with identical names but residing in different packages). If you need such conflict avoidance for @Bean methods as well, consider FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator.
items.translation: 如果因多个自动检测到的组件具有相同的非限定类名（即名称相同但位于不同包中的类）而导致命名冲突，请优先采用此 Bean 命名策略。如果您还需要对 @Bean 方法实现此类冲突避免，请考虑使用 FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator。

items.source: Note that an instance of this class is used by default for configuration-level import purposes; whereas, the default for component scanning purposes is a plain AnnotationBeanNameGenerator.
items.translation: 注意，该类的一个实例默认用于配置级别的导入；而组件扫描的默认值是一个普通的`AnnotationBeanNameGenerator`。

items.source: A convenient constant for a default FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator instance, as used for configuration-level import purposes.
items.translation: 一个用于配置级别导入目的的默认 `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 实例的便捷常量。

items.source:
The default implementation simply builds a decapitalized version
of the short class name: for example, "mypackage.MyJdbcDao" → "myJdbcDao".
items.translation: 默认实现仅构建短类名的去首字母大写版本：例如，"mypackage.MyJdbcDao" → "myJdbcDao"。

items.source:
Note that inner classes will thus have names of the form
"outerClassName.InnerClassName", which because of the period in the
name may be an issue if you are autowiring by name.
items.translation: 注意，内部类的名称将采用“outerClassName.InnerClassName”的形式，由于名称中包含点号，这可能会影响按名称进行自动线束（autowiring）的操作。

items.source: Derive a default bean name from the given bean definition.
items.translation: 从给定的 Bean 定义派生默认 Bean 名称。

items.source: definition - the bean definition to build a bean name for
items.translation: definition - 用于构建 Bean 名称的 Bean 定义
默认 Bean 名称（永远不为null）
